summary: Both edits carry every part of the intent and place them sensibly. Both add details the intent leaves out: the reason enum values, the input fields, and a one-report-per-booking claim. Several requirements are also repeated across the handler node, the new nodes and the edges.

findings.detail: The note names the reasons "(BookingReportReason: SPAM, DONT_KNOW_PERSON, OTHER)", but the intent only says "the three report reasons" and gives neither the enum name nor its values.

"Submit the report (booking UID, reason, optional description)" sets the input fields, including a booking UID input. The intent only says "validate the input" and "the supplied reason and optional description"; it mentions the UID only as a return value.

"(each booking has its existing report)" claims a cardinality the intent does not state. The intent only says to "load the booking with its existing report", and it says to return an "updated report count".

"Create the report with the supplied reason and optional description, record whether cancellation occurred, and leave watchlistId unset" appears on the handler modify note (bookings-trpc-router / booking-list-query), on the booking-report-repository node and on edge e-report-repo.
"verify the caller's access to the booking" appears on the handler modify note, on the booking-access-service node and on edge e-report-access.

The no-duplicate and no-repeated-cancellation rule appears on the handler modify note ("Handle an already-reported booking deliberately..."), on e-report-repo ("no duplicate reports on retry") and on e-report-cancel ("Avoid repeated cancellation work...").

"Load the booking with its existing report before making changes" appears on both the handler modify note and the read edge (e32 / e-listquery-reads). "Add the reporting action and dialog" and the badge, count and tooltip refresh appear on the list view or list page, on the report-booking-dialog node and on e-dialog-report. The watchlist scope exclusion appears on the handler note and again on the model node (fresh) or the watchlist edge (chain).

The "Optional watchlist relation on the report" is drawn as a model-to-service edge from booking-report-model to the watchlist service node ("Global and organization watchlist services"). It is a schema relation, so it belongs on the booking-report-model node, as fresh does. Placement only; the content matches fresh.
